subject: general
question: The H.C.F. and the L.C.M. of two numbers are 4 and 208 respectively. If one of the numbers is 52, find the other one.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product of numbers = **H.C.F.** × **L.C.M.**

52 × **Other number** = 4 × 208

**Other number** = (4 × 208) ÷ 52 = 4 × 4 = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**H.C.F.** = 4

**L.C.M.** = 208

**First Number** (n₁) = 52

**Formula Used:**

n₁ × n₂ = **H.C.F.** × **L.C.M.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e5673f878dfea8bc7915e3e37dd056ce971a846bb4cad2fbee6915b692c6a36.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 52 × n₂ = 4 × 208

⇒ n₂ = (4 × 208) ÷ 52

⇒ n₂ = 832 ÷ 52

⇒ n₂ = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Definition of H.C.F.

**Highest Common Factor** is the largest positive integer that divides each of the numbers without leaving a remainder.

Definition of L.C.M.

**Least Common Multiple** is the smallest positive integer that is divisible by both numbers.

Relation for more than two numbers

Note that the formula Product = H.C.F. × L.C.M. holds **strictly for two numbers** only.</p
